name: Zucchetti
description: Zucchetti ERP and HR suites over the Zucchetti REST / Infinity API: anagrafiche, documents, items and HR records. Basic or token auth against the customer's own Infinity or Ad Hoc installation. Partner credentials required.
instructions:
**Partner credentials required, and Zucchetti is not one product.** The group ships dozens of applications — Infinity Zucchetti, Ad Hoc Revolution, HR Zucchetti, Mago — each with its own API surface, versioning and documentation, distributed through the partner portal rather than publicly. There is no single `api.zucchetti.it`, and no public sandbox. This adapter therefore ships **unverified** and deliberately generic: it gives you an authenticated, paged HTTP client against a Zucchetti Infinity-style REST endpoint, and expects you to point it at the module you actually licensed.

**Setup**
1. Ask your Zucchetti partner for the REST endpoint of the installation and the API user. They will also tell you the service path prefix, which differs per module.
2. Set `ZUCCHETTI_URL` to that endpoint root (no trailing slash), plus `ZUCCHETTI_USERNAME` and `ZUCCHETTI_PASSWORD`.
3. Set `ZUCCHETTI_COMPANY` to the azienda code if the installation hosts several.

**`resource` is a parameter, not a path.** Because the entity names differ per module, `zucchetti_list_records` and `zucchetti_get_record` take the resource name (`anagrafiche`, `documenti`, `articoli`, `dipendenti`, …) as an argument. Your partner's documentation is the authority on which names your installation exposes.

**Start with `zucchetti_list_services`**, which asks the installation what it publishes. If it 404s, your endpoint prefix is different from the default and everything else will 404 too — fix that before anything else.

**Unverified.** The paths and field names below follow the vendor's published documentation and have not been exercised against a live tenant. Treat a 404 as a docs-versus-reality gap and check the developer portal before concluding that the credential is wrong. A correction from anyone running this against a real system is genuinely welcome.

**Self-hosted, which is the thing to plan for.**
- On **AnythingMCP Cloud** the instance must be reachable from the public internet on a real hostname with a valid TLS certificate. A self-signed certificate will fail: the connector offers no trust-anything switch.
- On an internal host (`zucchetti.intern`, `10.0.0.x`), self-host AnythingMCP on the same network and add that host to `SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, or the outbound guard refuses the call before it is made.

tools.name: zucchetti_list_services
tools.description: Ask the installation which REST services it publishes. Start here: if this 404s your endpoint prefix is wrong and every other call will fail the same way.

tools.name: zucchetti_list_records
tools.description: List records of any published resource with paging and a search fragment. The resource name differs per Zucchetti module — your partner's documentation is the authority.

resource.description: Resource name, e.g. anagrafiche, documenti, articoli, dipendenti.

search.description: Search fragment, where the resource supports one.

company.description: Azienda code, when the installation hosts several.

tools.name: zucchetti_get_record
tools.description: Read one record of any published resource by its id, with every field the API user is allowed to see.

resource.description: Resource name, e.g. anagrafiche or documenti.

tools.name: zucchetti_list_anagrafiche
tools.description: List anagrafiche — Zucchetti's customers and suppliers — with their code, name, partita IVA and address.

search.description: Search fragment matched against name and VAT number.

tools.name: zucchetti_list_documenti
tools.description: List documents (documenti) — invoices, orders and delivery notes — with their type, number, date, counterparty and total.

tipo.description: Document type code, as this installation defines it.

tools.name: zucchetti_list_articoli
tools.description: List items (articoli) from the catalogue with their code, description, unit of measure and price.

search.description: Search fragment matched against code and description.
